# Functions

Built-in functions, and how to write your own. 12 entries. Search all of them on the [reference home](./index.md).

In a pattern, `%type%` is a value, `[...]` is optional and `(a|b)` means one of the words.

## abs {#abs}

```carve
abs(%number%)
```

The number without its minus sign.

```carve
send "%abs(-3)%" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [expressions](../syntax/expressions.md)

## clamp, median, product {#w4_clamp}

```carve
clamp(%number%, %min%, %max%)
median(%numbers%)
product(%numbers%)
```

Keeps a number between two bounds; median and product take numbers or a list.

```carve
send "%clamp(15, 0, 10)%" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [functions-builtin-sections](../syntax/functions-builtin-sections.md)

## concat, formatNumber, toBase, fromBase, rgb, uuid {#w4_text}

```carve
concat(%objects%)
formatNumber(%number%, %pattern%)
toBase(%number%, %base%)
rgb(%r%, %g%, %b%[, %a%])
```

Text helpers: join values, format a number with a pattern, convert between bases, build a hex colour, parse a UUID.

```carve
send "%toBase(255, 16)%" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [functions-builtin-sections](../syntax/functions-builtin-sections.md)

## exp, ln, log, root, factorial, combinations, permutations, isNaN {#w4_math}

```carve
log(%number%[, %base%])
root(%number%[, %n%])
combinations(%n%, %k%)
```

Exponent, logarithms, roots and counting functions. `log` is base 10 unless a base is given.

```carve
send "%combinations(5, 2)%" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [functions-builtin-sections](../syntax/functions-builtin-sections.md)

## floor / ceil / round {#floor}

```carve
floor(%number%)
ceil(%number%)
ceiling(%number%)
round(%number%)
round(%number%, %number%)
```

Rounds down, up, or to the nearest whole number. `round(n, places)` keeps that many decimal places.

```carve
send "%round(2.6)% %round(3.14159, 2)%" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [expressions](../syntax/expressions.md)

## location {#location}

```carve
location(%number%, %number%, %number%[, %world%])
```

Makes a location, optionally in a world.

```carve
teleport player to location(0, 64, 0)
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [types](../syntax/types.md)

## min / max {#min_max}

```carve
min(%number%, %number%, ...)
max(%number%, %number%, ...)
```

The smallest or biggest of two or more numbers.

```carve
send "%max(3, 7, 5)%" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [expressions](../syntax/expressions.md)

## mod {#mod}

```carve
mod(%number%, %number%)
```

Remainder, always 0 or more: `mod(-1, 5)` is 4.

```carve
send "%mod(7, 3)%" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [expressions](../syntax/expressions.md)

## player, offlinePlayer, calcExperience {#w4_player}

```carve
player(%name or uuid%)
offlinePlayer(%name or uuid%)
calcExperience(%level%)
```

Looks a player up by name or UUID, and gives the experience points a level needs.

```carve
send "%calcExperience(10)%" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [functions-builtin-sections](../syntax/functions-builtin-sections.md)

## Script functions {#script_function}

```carve
function <name>([<param>: <type> [= <default>], ...]) [:: <type>]:
```

Defines a function callable from any script, as a value or on its own line. A script function wins over a built-in with the same name.

```carve
function coins(p: player) :: number:
    return {coins::%uuid of {_p}%} ? 0
on join:
    send "%coins(player)% coins" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [functions](../syntax/functions.md)

## sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan, atan2 {#w4_trig}

```carve
sin(%number%)
atan2(%number%, %number%)
```

Trigonometry in degrees. The inverse functions return degrees.

```carve
send "%sin(30)%" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [functions-builtin-sections](../syntax/functions-builtin-sections.md)

## sqrt {#sqrt}

```carve
sqrt(%number%)
```

Square root. A negative number is an error.

```carve
send "%sqrt(16)%" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [expressions](../syntax/expressions.md)
